facts.value: Entry selects 0x163, seeds x0 as x58 + HSD_Randi(x54 - x58), and clears x4. On each upward callback invocation with no animation frames remaining, x4 is set and x0 pre-decremented. A negative result clears x4 and self_vel.x/y, enters 0x164, initializes animation processing, and plays 0x4E207. No local restart is performed for a nonnegative result. Wait completion calls ftCh_GrabUnk1_8015BC88. IASA forwards only for human slots; collision is locally empty.

evidence.why: Complete gated vector calculation and component writes.

facts.rationale: Distinguishes intermediate vector scaling from the two-component output and avoids an unsupported one-update arrival guarantee.
facts.value: After an unconditional ft_80085134 call, additional steering runs only for nonzero mv.ch.unk13.x4. It computes a three-dimensional displacement to the attribute-offset reference position with destination z set to zero. If its length is strictly below x14, displacement x/y are copied to self velocity; otherwise the displacement is normalized and scaled by len*x10 before copying x/y. Equality follows the latter branch. This callback does not directly write self_vel.z or guarantee full three-dimensional arrival or velocity magnitude.
